mapper.update: UPDATE backfill_batch SET status = 'PAUSED', version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND deleted = false
UPDATE backfill_batch SET status = 'RUNNING', version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PAUSED' AND deleted = false
UPDATE backfill_batch SET status = 'RUNNING', finished_at = NULL, duration_ms = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DONE' AND deleted = false

UPDATE backfill_batch SET success_count = #{success}, failed_count = #{failed}, waiting_count = #{waiting}, status = CASE WHEN #{waiting} = 0 AND #{inflight} = 0 AND status = 'RUNNING' THEN 'DONE' ELSE status END, finished_at = CASE WHEN #{waiting} = 0 AND #{inflight} = 0 AND status = 'RUNNING' THEN now() ELSE finished_at END, duration_ms = CASE WHEN #{waiting} = 0 AND #{inflight} = 0 AND status = 'RUNNING' THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - submitted_at))::bigint * 1000 ELSE duration_ms END, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = false
